bc6a5de499.q: How should account managers balance serving current clients with identifying new growth opportunities?
bc6a5de499.a: Account managers need to strike a balance where they are responsible for current workload and clients but also look for opportunities. 078410809c.q: What is the trigger moment when agencies should ask happy clients for referrals?
078410809c.a: The optimal moment typically occurs around 90 days into a new client relationship when they are happy and say things like 'this is amazing, this is great work.' Most agencies do nothing at this moment or only ask for case studies or testimonials. 1b7ce97054.q: Why do agencies maintain competitive advantages over AI despite emerging tools and in-house capabilities?
1b7ce97054.a: Agencies have advantage because clients are outsourcing liability and risk, not just buying labor or information. High-trust service providers in specialized markets want a 'throat to choke'—someone responsible if things go wrong. Clients need to know the agency represents enough of their revenue that losing the business would hurt, ensuring proper attention to high-stakes work like website rebuilds or campaigns.
